title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Satin Nickel | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch | Allied Brass, Satin Nickel
description:
Upgrade bathroom towel storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms. This straight-bar design is part of the Que New collection, created to coordinate with matching versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- , including statement colors
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and installation hardware

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 inches

- Projection: 3 inches
- Overall size: 33 inches W x 3 inches H x 3 inches projection
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
